notes: Configuration all_payloads: the weight log of the Master Specification Sheet (Redback Master SpreadSheet - V2 Weight Breakdown.csv), total row Total Weight.
Motors, propellers, ESCs and motor mounts are point masses at the four hubs, the boom arms are point masses half way along the arm, and all other mass is at the origin (user rules, 2026-10-16).
The inertia is the parallel-axis sum of the point masses. A part has no inertia of its own in it.

Multirotor. The design frame origin is the middle of the four hubs (the body origin). s_ref: the frontal area of the demo body box (y times z), a placeholder. b_ref: the hub-to-hub distance in y. c_ref: the hub-to-hub distance in x.
MRP = the CG of the mass model (SpecSheet spoke). It is a mass model value (placeholder).
